# Basic iptables rules for testing stop-bots
# This file contains sample iptables rules that might be generated or parsed

*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD DROP [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:STOP-BOTS - [0:0]

# Allow established connections
-I INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
-I INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT

# Jump to STOP-BOTS chain
-I INPUT -j STOP-BOTS

# STOP-BOTS chain rules for blocking bots
-A STOP-BOTS -s 1.2.3.4 -j DROP
-A STOP-BOTS -s 5.6.7.0/24 -j DROP
-A STOP-BOTS -s 8.9.10.11 -p tcp --dport 80 -j DROP
-A STOP-BOTS -s 12.13.14.15 -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-host-prohibited

# Allow good bots (crawlers)
-A STOP-BOTS -s 66.249.64.0/19 -j ACCEPT  # Googlebot
-A STOP-BOTS -s 157.240.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT   # Bingbot

COMMIT
